_comment: Ordered list of images for the Maternity gallery. Files live in public/images/maternity/. Naming: maternity-01-short-description.jpg. EMPTY UNTIL SELECTED. emptyGalleryNote and emptyGalleryCallout render on the page ONLY while images is empty — once real photos are added, delete both fields (or leave them; they'll simply stop showing once images.length > 0, no cleanup required).
emptyGalleryNote: You may notice there's no gallery here yet. Most maternity photos are personal, and plenty of clients understandably don't want theirs posted publicly — so this page is quiet on purpose, not by accident. If you'd like to see a few examples privately, message me and I'm happy to share some with permission.
emptyGalleryCallout: I'm also currently looking for a few moms willing to let me feature some faceless, belly-only images here, with a model discount as a thank-you. If that could be you, I'd love to talk.
_selectionGuidance: Show range rather than one look, because the page promises a client-led session: mother alone and mother with partner, at least one with existing children, and a mix of flowing-dress and everyday-clothing styling. Avoid making the gallery read as one uniform aesthetic.
